title: Dual-Major Champion Basket 2026 UNSEEN Benchmark - GBPUSD M30
research_question: Does the validated GBPUSD M30 champion (EXP-0034 training PF 3.20, EXP-0035 validation PF 2.29) maintain positive net profit (PF >= 1.20, Net Profit > $0.00, Max DD <= 6.0%) across the strictly out-of-sample 2026 UNSEEN dataset partition (2026.01.01 to 2026.09.30)?
hypothesis: Because the GBPUSD M30 Fibonacci pullback edge with London/NY session filters and 15-pip SL/TP demonstrated robust out-of-sample generalization across both 2020-2024 training and 2025 validation, the identical untouched strategy configuration will remain profitable and within prop firm drawdown limits across the 2026 UNSEEN dataset.

facts: In EXP-0034 across 2020-2024 training, GBPUSD M30 achieved +$663.45 net profit, PF 3.20, 78.1% win rate, and 3.52% max drawdown.
In EXP-0035 across 2025 validation, GBPUSD M30 confirmed out-of-sample edge with +$637.23 net profit, PF 2.29, 81.3% win rate, and 3.93% max drawdown.
Across 10,000 Monte Carlo bootstrap iterations, the GBPUSD strategy maintained a 95% positive expected return.
inferences: GBPUSD M30 structure is stable across differing annual volatility regimes.
Evaluating untouched champion parameters on the 2026 UNSEEN partition provides the final empirical test before live demo deployment.

assumptions: Broker tick data quality for 2026 on Deriv-Demo is >= 99.0%.
